findings.rationale: The pinned OpenZeppelin IERC20 interface keeps its broad upstream pragma for compatibility.
AGTMAIToken.INITIAL_SUPPLY intentionally uses uppercase for an immutable constructor-assigned value with no reassignment path.
Constructor complexity comes from fail-closed validation of at most 32 immutable genesis allocations.
The pinned OpenZeppelin ERC20 implementation intentionally retains its compatible upstream pragma.
The pinned OpenZeppelin IERC20Metadata interface keeps its broad upstream compatibility pragma.

INITIAL_CCIP_ADMIN intentionally uses uppercase naming for a private immutable deployment value. The constructor rejects zero and assigns it once; getCCIPAdmin only returns it. This field introduces no setter, mint authority or token administration capability.
AGTMAIToken.GENESIS_ALLOCATION_HASH intentionally uses uppercase for an immutable constructor-assigned value with no reassignment path.
The constructor-only allocation validation loop is explicitly bounded to 32 entries before execution.
The bounded constructor mint loop must write each recipient balance and emit its allocation event once.

The inherited bytes32 literal encodes the zero-padded ASCII domain AGTMAI_ALLOCATION_V1. It intentionally domain-separates the canonical abi.encode genesis allocation hash; it is not an arithmetic quantity. Slither now attributes the inherited constant initialization to AGTMAICCIPToken.
The pinned OpenZeppelin draft IERC-6093 file keeps its upstream compiler compatibility range.
GrantVault deliberately rejects block timestamps that cannot be represented by its uint64 accounting clock before narrowing the value.
Funding intentionally compares trusted chain time with the immutable grant start so a reserve cannot activate a backdated schedule.
Construction intentionally compares trusted chain time with the supplied grant start and rejects schedules that are already backdated.
TOKEN is an intentionally uppercase public immutable binding in GrantVault's reviewed fixed-binding ABI and has no reassignment path.
ORIGINAL_RESERVE is an intentionally uppercase public immutable binding in GrantVault's reviewed fixed-binding ABI and has no reassignment path.
CONTROLLER is an intentionally uppercase public immutable binding in GrantVault's reviewed fixed-binding ABI and has no reassignment path.
The refund comparison only skips a zero-value ERC20 transfer; refund is the accounting result and the timestamp-dependent entitlement is already fixed by GrantAccounting.
BENEFICIARY is an intentionally uppercase public immutable binding in GrantVault's reviewed fixed-binding ABI and has no reassignment path.
The movement helper receives only token balance snapshots and an amount; its comparisons enforce exact debit and credit and do not read or compare a timestamp.

ReserveController holds its lock through approval, funding, reset and GrantCommitted emission. ReserveControllerReentrancyTest proves authorized callbacks at all three call sites fail ReentrantCall and exactly one correctly bound event is emitted per successful commitment; reset failure reverts the transaction before event emission.
Variable ReserveController.PURPOSE intentionally uses uppercase for an immutable constructor-assigned binding with no reassignment path.
Chain time intentionally defines (now - 365 days, now]; upper-bound search expires the exact cutoff. Boundary, staggered-expiry and independent-history fuzz tests cover this policy.
Variable ReserveController.TOKEN intentionally uses uppercase for an immutable constructor-assigned binding with no reassignment path.
Variable FounderGrantReserve.TOKEN intentionally uses uppercase for an immutable constructor-assigned binding with no reassignment path.
grossCommitted compares array length, not time, and returns lifetime cumulative commitments even after all checkpoints expire; testEmptySameTimestampAndFullyExpiredHistory proves this.
Variable ReserveController.ROLLING_CAP intentionally uses uppercase for an immutable constructor-assigned binding with no reassignment path.
Variable ReserveController.CONTROLLER intentionally uses uppercase for an immutable constructor-assigned binding with no reassignment path.
Variable ReserveController.PER_GRANT_CAP intentionally uses uppercase for an immutable constructor-assigned binding with no reassignment path.

Commitment timestamps intentionally merge equal-time checkpoints and enforce gross rolling authority. testMergedCapExpiresTogetherAtExactWindowBoundary proves joint expiry; pre-cliff refund coverage proves inventory refunds do not restore authority.
Variable FounderGrantReserve.VAULT intentionally uses uppercase for an immutable constructor-assigned binding with no reassignment path.
WINDOW_SECONDS intentionally names an immutable constructor-assigned duration in uppercase; no setter exists.
ROLLING_CAP intentionally names an immutable constructor-assigned cap in uppercase; no setter exists.
TOKEN intentionally names an immutable token-address binding in uppercase; this naming does not authenticate the token implementation.
CONTROLLER intentionally names an immutable authorization address in uppercase; Safe qualification remains separate.
OPENS_AT intentionally names an immutable constructor-assigned opening timestamp in uppercase; no setter exists.
PURPOSE intentionally names an immutable purpose label in uppercase; it does not constrain recipients’ downstream spending.
Chain time intentionally defines (now - WINDOW_SECONDS, now]; upper-bound search excludes the exact cutoff, and the pre-subtraction branch prevents underflow.
Availability is intentionally zero before opening and afterward is the lesser of inventory and remaining rolling capacity.
grossOutflow compares array length, not time, and retains lifetime cumulative outflow after checkpoints expire.
Chain time intentionally controls opening, rolling-cap expiry and same-timestamp coalescing; it is not used as randomness.
The lock remains held through exact balance verification and Outflow emission; failed transfers revert accounting and logs, and nested transfers cannot reorder vault outflows.
All eight production sources require solc 0.8.36, compatible with the pinned OpenZeppelin ranges; differing source constraints do not select different compilers.
